info.name: Employee Training Management API
info.description:
Postman collection for the ABC Technologies Employee Training Management API (.NET 8).

1. Start the API (`dotnet run --project TrainingManagementApi`) and set the `baseUrl` collection variable if it is not http://localhost:5282.
2. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner > Run collection). Every request has tests; ids are passed between requests automatically.
3. The run leaves the database as it found it (folder 4 deletes what folders 1-3 created).
